summary: Initializer that writes three consecutive dwords on an object (this in EAX, parameter passed via ECX): field 0xC is set from the ECX parameter, and fields 0x10 and 0x14 are both set to 1101004800 (20.0f). Returns this unchanged.

operations.description: Set field at offset 0xC from the ECX parameter a2.
Set field at offset 0x10 to 1101004800, the bit pattern of 20.0f.
Set field at offset 0x14 to 1101004800, the bit pattern of 20.0f.
Return this (result) unchanged after the writes.

unresolved: Meaning of the ECX parameter a2 and the identity of the owning object are unknown.
Whether the 20.0f values are initialized positions or sizes is not evidenced.
